edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender address of _transferFrom, letting the caller choose the debited account
claimDividend forwards msg.sender to distributor.claimDividend without access checks
onlyOwner modifier validates msg.sender against owner before openTrading executes
block.timestamp is supplied as the DEX deadline parameter in swapBack, creating timestamp dependency
swapping modifier sets inSwap true while swapBack runs, blocking reentrant state changes
swapBack invokes the external router swap to convert contract tokens into ETH
The DEX router callback during the swap can re-enter the token logic before swapBack completes
swapBack sends ETH out to marketing and treasury, an external value transfer during swap state changes
tradingOpen must be true for non-owner transfers, gating all user transfers
isBot mapping blocks flagged addresses from transferring tokens
owner address bypasses tradingOpen, bot and buy-limit restrictions in _transferFrom
openTrading can only be called by the owner
launchedAt block number determines automatic bot flagging of early recipients
totalFee is read by takeFee to compute the fee amount
_transferFrom reads _balances to check and compute sender and recipient balances
_transferFrom writes updated sender and recipient balances into _balances
_transferFrom performs external try/catch distributor.setShare calls after balance updates
the distributor state variable is the target contract of the setShare external call
distributeDividend transfers ETH to the shareholder invoking external code from the distributor
setShare calls distributeDividend to settle pending dividends before updating shares
shares mapping values drive the dividend amounts computed inside distributeDividend
deposit performs mul/div arithmetic to increase dividendsPerShare
dividendsPerShareAccuracyFactor is used as divisor in deposit and cumulative dividend math
marketingWallet is the destination of half of the swapped ETH
treasury is the destination of half of the swapped ETH
claimDividend calls the external distributor.claimDividend which can transfer ETH
maxBuy caps the transfer amount when the buy limit is active
buyLimit flag enables the maximum buy amount check in _transferFrom
setFee writes totalFee and is restricted to the owner with a 14 percent cap
setFee is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
setTreasury is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
setTreasury updates the treasury payable address used for swap proceeds
manualSend transfers the entire contract ETH balance to the marketing wallet
isDividendExempt decides whether distributor shares are updated after a transfer
isFeeExempt feeds shouldTakeFee which decides if takeFee applies
sender parameter is used for balance subtraction and dividend share updates
recipient parameter is used for balance addition and dividend share updates
amount parameter is used in SafeMath subtraction from the sender balance
local amountReceived is used to credit the recipient balance and emit the transfer
_transferFrom assigns the post-fee value into the local amountReceived variable
amount is multiplied by totalFee and divided by feeDenominator inside takeFee
holder parameter selects which shareholder receives the dividend claim
_fee parameter is validated and written into totalFee
_setIsDividendExempt is only reachable through owner-restricted setters such as setIsDividendExempt
_setIsDividendExempt calls the external distributor.setShare to resync exempt holders

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a transient input local to _transferFrom and should be folded into that core function node
recipient is a transient input local to _transferFrom and should be folded into that core function node
amount is a transient input local to _transferFrom that only modifies balance and fee state
amountReceived is a temporary intermediate value produced and consumed only inside _transferFrom
holder is a transient caller-supplied parameter used solely by the claimDividend function
_fee is a transient caller-supplied parameter used solely by the setFee function
